title: Ropes & Gray develops transactional diligence AI tool with OpenAI
excerpt: The law firm is building a tool to assist with the first pass of document review during transactional diligence.
bodyHtml:
OpenAI reported on October 29, 2026, that law firm Ropes & Gray is developing a transactional diligence AI tool in partnership with OpenAI. Transactional diligence requires lawyers to investigate a seller’s financial and legal claims before an acquisition, a process that involves parsing large volumes of documents.

The tool is designed to take a first pass by combing through thousands of pages, identifying relevant documents, and automatically grouping them by themes and issues. It produces summaries and a report in the firm's signature format. The tool inventories and categorizes a data room to review full relationships between documents.

The initial development work has focused on material commercial contracts. The tool is comparable to the work of a capable junior-to-mid-level associate, providing a first pass through the process. Lawyers continue to review interim summaries and source documents to ensure the work is accurate before delivery to clients. Ropes & Gray has described an ambition for the tool to produce a detailed, issue-level diligence report in hours rather than weeks.
topic: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
